method: Actual full-browser CDP JPEG frames to H264 VFR; absolute original timestamps quantized to1ms BEFORE deriving duration differences, preventing accumulated rounding drift; option framerate1000 provides1ms input timebase; explicit encoder/container1/1000; no fps filter, interpolation, duplication, dropped frames or speed changes. One real whole-browser stream per clip; no independent native stream claimed.
timelineOrder: All original frames sorted by their unchanged CDP capture timestamps, not delivery order. Original delivery list retained in capture.json.
rawJPEGRetention: Ignored execution cache only; every original source frame timestamp/hash is checkpointed in capture.json, the encoded MP4 is checkpointed.
